commands.command:
mkdir -p /root/fleet-ca/{ca,certs,private} && chmod 700 /root/fleet-ca/private && cd /root/fleet-ca && \
openssl genrsa -out private/ca.key 4096 && \
openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key private/ca.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=Fleet Internal CA/O=Fleet Internal CA" \
  -out ca/ca.crt && \
echo DONE && openssl x509 -in ca/ca.crt -noout -subject -dates
commands.stdout:
DONE
subject=CN = Fleet Internal CA, O = Fleet Internal CA
notBefore=Sep 30 00:16:04 2026 GMT
notAfter=Sep 27 00:16:04 2036 GMT

commands.command:
cd /root/fleet-ca && \
openssl genrsa -out private/node2.key 2048 && \
cat > node2.ext <<'EOF'
subjectAltName = DNS:node2,IP:10.100.159.11
extendedKeyUsage = serverAuth
keyUsage = digitalSignature, keyEncipherment
EOF
openssl req -new -key private/node2.key -subj "/CN=node2" -out node2.csr && \
openssl x509 -req -in node2.csr -CA ca/ca.crt -CAkey private/ca.key -CAcreateserial \
  -out certs/node2.crt -days 825 -sha256 -extfile node2.ext && \
echo DONE && openssl x509 -in certs/node2.crt -noout -subject -issuer -ext subjectAltName
